title: AI Solutions Program Manager, Finance
description:
Who we are  

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

You'll be joining the Finance Operational Excellence team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operational Excellence. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. You’ll have room to shape how applied AI is built and scaled both from a technical and end-user perspective.

What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.  You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term. 

You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.

Responsibilities

description:
Success Manager - Partner Insights & Enablement

Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country.  Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere.

For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

The Opportunity

The Customer Success Manager will sit within the Success team on the Partner Insights, Enablement and Success team. This role will own strategic customer relationships with healthcare systems, life sciences organizations, and research partners, helping customers translate complex clinical questions into successful real-world data and evidence workflows. The ideal candidate combines enterprise healthcare technology customer success experience - especially experience with EMR data or EMR vendors - with a strong foundation in clinical practice, real-world data or evidence, public health, outcomes research, or epidemiology. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own a portfolio of Truveta customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, research execution, renewal readiness, and expansion. Develop success plans, establish measurable outcomes, and ensure customers realize sustained value from Truveta. 
  • Guide customers through research and analytics workflows, including cohort definition, feasibility assessment, study design considerations, data interpretation, and effective use of Truveta products and services. 
  • Translate customer goals, clinical workflows, and research questions into clear requirements, action plans, and deliverables. Coordinate across product, research, engineering, commercial, and support teams to drive resolution and progress. 
  • Manage customer education, enablement, training, and stakeholder and executive-ready communications. Clearly summarize research findings, product capabilities, risks, and recommendations in Truveta-branded reports, slide decks, and presentations. 
  • Build trusted relationships with clinical, operational, informatics, analytics, and research stakeholders at health systems and life sciences organizations. Serve as a strategic advisor and customer advocate. 
  • Identify opportunities to deepen product adoption and expand customer impact. Partner with commercial teams on account planning, renewal preparation, and growth opportunities. 
  • Proactively identify delivery, workflow, or adoption risks and develop practical recommendations for resolution. 
  • Occasional but mandatory domestic travel (~2-5x/yr), plus the ability to attend virtual meetings across US time zones. 

Required Skills:

  • 4+ years of experience working in a field which developed exposure to and understanding of electronic medical record (EMR) data, real-world data (RWD), real world evidence (RWE), public health research, or regulatory submissions. 
  • 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, consulting, ideally with a focus on life science or healthcare analytics customers. 
  • Demonstrated experience with public health research, epidemiology, outcomes research, health services research, real-world data (RWD), real-world evidence (RWE), or clinical research. 
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to align clinical, technical, operational, and executive audiences around shared goals and deliverables. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific, analytical, and technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of familiarity.

title: CX Operations Enablement Specialist
description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a CX Operations Enablement Specialist to serve as the operational translator and steward of our Customer Experience knowledge ecosystem. In this role, you will tear down process friction, embed our "Trust-First" support philosophy, and ensure our frontline human agents and AI support tools have access to highly accurate, empathetic, and actionable information. Partnering closely with Operations, Product, QA, Training, and AI Strategy teams, you will architect SOPs, manage our knowledge libraries, and empower support teams to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the operational owner of Customer Experience knowledge, managing the customer-facing Help Center and internal Knowledge Library
  • Lead the comprehensive teardown and rebuild of legacy SOPs, replacing rigid policies with workflows anchored in our core framework: Acknowledge, Empathize, Verify, Resolve
  • Build localized, compliant SOPs and decision trees for complex operational workflows, such as Dynamic Pricing disputes and 3rd-Party Reservation failures
  • Own, restructure, and maintain the Gladly CRM macro library (CX Answers) and FAQs to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) while aligning with the Metropolis brand voice
  • Serve as the primary CX liaison to Operations Launch teams, ensuring localized knowledge assets and documentation are delivered prior to go-live for new locations
  • Act as the direct operational bridge to Experience Integrity and Government Relations to establish strictly compliant agent guardrails for regulatory-sensitive workflows
  • Structure organizational knowledge clearly so it can be effectively ingested and retrieved by our AI Agent (Parker) and internal LLMs
  • Partner with CX AI Content Analysts to close documentation gaps that cause AI hallucinations or routing failures
  • Conduct recurring knowledge audits to identify gaps, partnering with QA and Training to ensure operational alignment

What we're looking for

  • Experience managing or maintaining knowledge bases, help centers, or complex SOP documentation systems such as Gladly, Zendesk, Guru, or Confluence
  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, or a fast-paced operational environment
  • Strong technical writing, editing, and documentation skills with a hyper-focus on clarity, empathy, and usability
  • Ability to translate complex, localized operational and legal requirements into user-friendly documentation for frontline BPO agents
  • Strong project management skills, specifically in driving cross-functional alignment ahead of strict launch deadlines
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

  • Experience supporting AI-powered customer support solutions or familiarity with generative AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT
  • Experience with Gladly, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar CRM platforms
  • Experience creating customer support documentation at scale
  • Understanding of information architecture, content strategy, and knowledge management best practices

4 Days in Office: Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection

When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $63,000.00 USD to $75,000.00 USD annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. title: Lead Front End Architect/Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Front End to lead the architecture and hands-on delivery of the interfaces our customers use to build and manage HCP journeys. You will lead front-end engineering, hire and grow the team behind it, and partner closely with the back end lead and product designer so the platform's interface, data model, and design system evolve together. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead front-end architecture and hands-on delivery for the platform's user-facing product, from early prototypes through production.
  • Lead the journey-builder canvas — a direct-manipulation, graph-based interface — as it scales to more complex journeys and larger data volumes.
  • Define API contracts together with the back end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system.
  • Drive the code side of the design system and the design-to-code workflow, in partnership with the product designer, who leads the design system itself.
  • Direct how AI-driven guardrails and model behavior are rendered and made trustworthy in the product.
  • Hire and lead a front-end engineering team as it grows, setting a high bar for code quality and CI-enforced testing.
  • Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use.
  • Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • 8+ years in front-end or full-stack engineering, including 2+ years leading a team.
  • Experience leading front-end architecture for a B2B or enterprise product, ideally one with a complex, data-dense, or direct-manipulation UI (a canvas, graph editor, or similar).
  • Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch.
  • Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced.
  • Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous product problems into a sequenced, shippable technical plan.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, still-small engineering org.
  • Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems).

 

Pay Range: $175,000-$200,000

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

title: Clinical Affairs Pipeline
description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

Anteris Technologies is advancing innovative structural heart technologies designed to redefine expectations in the treatment of aortic stenosis. Our Clinical Affairs team plays a critical role in generating clinical evidence, supporting physicians and clinical sites, and executing global clinical programs that advance our technologies from clinical development through commercialization.

We are interested in connecting with Clinical Affairs professionals with experience in areas such as:

  • Clinical trial strategy, planning, and execution
  • Clinical operations and clinical project management
  • Clinical site management and monitoring
  • Field clinical support and physician education
  • Clinical research and scientific evidence generation
  • Clinical data review, analysis, and interpretation

title: Corporate Marketing Operations Manager
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


About the role
The Operations Manager is part of Avalere Health’s Corporate Marketing Team, which is responsible for developing and delivering the corporate brand, thought leadership, PR, and integrated marketing activity. The role partners closely with digital specialists to ensure the platforms, systems, and data underpinning integrated campaigns operate reliably and efficiently, supporting increased awareness, strengthened reputation, and commercial opportunities. 
Reporting to the Associate Director of Corporate Marketing, this role is accountable for the operational infrastructure that enables the wider team to deliver against the marketing goals of the Group corporate brand, as well as Avalere Health's three capabilities – Advisory, Medical, and Marketing. 
The role is central to the effective functioning of Corporate Marketing, providing the team with the platform integration, resourcing visibility and performance insight required to plan and deliver on strategic goals with confidence. 
  
What You'll Do
Operational excellence and process management 
Develop a culture and processes of operational excellence within the Corporate Marketing team, leading on all Corporate Marketing process development and implementation. 


 What we can offer You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program, as well as personalized health support. Enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey, as well as on-demand support from our partner Peppy. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Growth Manager (Berlin)
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Growth Manager (Berlin) Salary Range: €55K – €75K • Offers Bonus At a Glance You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes. Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong. Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day. Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint. Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner. Contribute to the playbook. title: Peer Review Operations Specialist - 2 Year FTC
description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

As a Peer Review Operations Specialist, you are a confident and highly organized self-starter, motivated by a culture of continuous improvement. You’re an excellent communicator and a natural team player, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and hold yourself accountable for meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Reporting to the Peer Review Operations Manager, you work as a member of the Peer Review Operations team to maintain efficient peer review workflows, ensure high vendor performance standards, and uphold excellent contributor experience for authors, editors, and reviewers. You will enforce turnaround time benchmarks for all peer review milestones to protect process integrity and ensure timeliness and quality of publication. You will have high standards of professional conduct in the workplace, and enjoy working with international colleagues from a range of cultures and settings. You will seek out opportunities for continuous quality improvement in department activities and be an effective champion of the PLOS vision, mission, and brand.

Responsibilities

Submission Management 

  • Ensure the timely, efficient peer review of all submissions
  • Ensure that queries or concerns escalated by vendors, Customer Care or other PLOS colleagues are addressed and resolved professionally and within required timelines, or escalated appropriately
  • Identify and remove barriers to submission, working collaboratively with colleagues across PLOS as required
  • Proactively identify workflow inefficiencies, variations or backlogs to diagnose persistent issues 
  • Ensure that manuscripts meet requirements and follow current policies and procedures

Workflows 

  • Troubleshoot persistent manuscript, workflow or system issues, providing expertise and advice, and exercising judgement to resolve the issue or escalate to the Peer Review Operations Manager or other colleagues as appropriate
  • Proactively raise data-driven recommendations for continuous journal operations and workflow improvements to the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Ensure standard journal workflows are maintained as established, implementing and adopting process updates when approved by the Peer Review Operations Manager

Projects 

  • Contribute to workflow project and initiate proposals as requested, and undertake operations projects and initiatives as directed by the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Serve as daily liaison with vendor representatives, monitoring quality and timeliness performance against target thresholds and KPIs

Other 

  • Contribute to other operational research outputs related to PLOS’s mission where required, so that our journal workflows are optimised to encourage scientific openness and transparency

Knowledge and Skills

Essential

  • Prior experience in peer-reviewed schololarly publishing
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral
  • Growth mindset with a collaborative, team player mentality
  • An ability to maintain a positive and professional customer service attitude
  • Able to work constructively with vendors, authors, editors, customers, and colleagues from a range of international settings
  • Knowledge of Excel, Word, file types and file conversions
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy
  • Able to set priorities and work independently

  • An interest in science and in advancing scientific knowledge

Desirable

  • Knowledge of and expertise with peer review and manuscript management database systems; proficiency with Editorial Manager a plus
  • Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) software such as Salesforce
  • Awareness of and commitment to open science

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some domestic and international travel required.

Qualifications

  • A university degree or equivalent experience

title: Commercial Manager, Supply Chain
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain

We're looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a global role spanning the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem, with Deliveroo as the hiring entity. This is a hybrid role based in our London office.

In this role, you'll help shape what our global supply chain looks like as DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt increasingly act as one unified company — building a highly efficient commercial approach to how physical goods, logistics, and courier equipment move across our operations worldwide. Rather than three brands running separate playbooks, you'll help design the single commercial model that brings them together, turning fragmented regional practices into one coherent, scalable supply chain.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sitting underneath the Senior Commercial Manager, you will build and execute sourcing strategies, lead complex international negotiations, and manage supplier performance across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.

 

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

 

Sourcing Strategy & Execution

  • Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.

     

  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.

     

  • Build and execute robust negotiation positions, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.

     

Contract & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end contracting process in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.

     

  • Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.

     

  • Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.

     

  • Partner with operational and logistics leadership to align requirements, streamline specifications, and build credibility across historically independent regional teams.

     

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in supply chain sourcing, with a proven track record delivering measurable commercial value across logistics, 3PL, or manufactured goods categories.

     

  • Demonstrated ability in end-to-end competitive sourcing, including hands-on contract negotiation with major international suppliers and manufacturing partners.

     

  • Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.

     

  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.

     

  • Exceptional stakeholder influence, with the ability to bridge operational needs with commercial outcomes across multi-region or cross-brand environments.

     

Nice to Have

  • Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.

     

  • Experience leading post-acquisition supplier consolidation or specification harmonisation.

     

  • Familiarity with direct/inventory-based supply chains, including international freight, customs/duty, and working capital dynamics.

     

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

 

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones. Skills required PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred) Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet) Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly Component selection and BOM management Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus Responsibilities: Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections. PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints. Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management. Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan. Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes. Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed. EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections. Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up. Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding). Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions. Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications. title: Lead Back End Architect/Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry Media is transforming how medical and healthcare marketers engage healthcare professionals (HCPs) and consumers through data, technology, and omnichannel innovation. Real Chemistry Media's product and technology teams sit at the heart of this meaningful work by building tools that increase impact. In support of our mission to help life-changing medicines and therapies reach their full market potential, we are building an enterprise platform for omnichannel orchestration in healthcare marketing.

Our technology enables healthcare organizations to design, deploy, and optimize HCP journeys through a scalable, self-service product that connects to their existing marketing and data systems. The platform is live with early users and on track with rapid growth milestones, so the decisions made over the next year will be influential in shaping the product's future.

We are hiring a Lead Engineer, Back End to drive the services and data model that power the platform. You will lead back-end architecture and hands-on delivery, hire and grow a team of back-end and data engineers, and direct how the platform's data scales, stays reliable, and connects to the systems around it. The team is small and we're building a lot, so there are a lot of opportunities for ownership and influence.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the platform's application data model in Aurora and DynamoDB, and the access-pattern decisions behind it, as the product scales.
  • Drive the integration contract with our data warehouse — what flows each way, on what cadence — and keep the warehouse out of the platform's request path.
  • Define API contracts together with the front end lead, so the interface and the data model evolve as one system.
  • Direct the reliability, performance, and cost of back-end services, partnering with DevOps on the platform-level non-functional requirements that take both teams' input.
  • Partner with data science to productionize the models and recommendation features built on top of the platform's data.
  • Hire and lead a team of back-end and data engineers, setting a high bar for code quality and CI-enforced testing.
  • Support and set standards for agentic coding on your team, backed by real company investment in the tools, not just tolerance for their use.
  • Partner with product and design on problem definition, scope, and sequencing from the start of each effort.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What You Should Have:

  • 8+ years in back-end or full-stack engineering, including 2+ years leading a team.
  • Experience leading a data model and access patterns for a B2B or enterprise product at meaningful scale, ideally across both a relational and a NoSQL store.
  • Track record hiring and growing engineers, and running a technical interview loop from scratch.
  • Comfortable directing and reviewing agentic or AI-assisted coding, with the judgment to know what to hold to human review regardless of how the code was produced.
  • Experience partnering with data science or ML teams to get models into production.
  • Fluency defining and maintaining API contracts across a team boundary.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-moving, still-small engineering org.
  • Bonus points for pharma or HCP marketing experience — or any complex, regulated marketing data environment (ad tech, financial services marketing, health systems).

 

Pay Range: $175,000-$200,000

The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Patient Care Coordinator- Gardner

SERC Physical Therapy, a brand partner of Upstream Rehabilitation, is looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join our team in Gardner, KS

 

Are you looking for a position in a growing organization where you can make a significant impact on the lives of others? 

What is a Patient Care Coordinator?

  • A Patient Care Coordinator is an entry-level office role that is responsible for maintaining pleasant and consistent daily operations of the clinic.
  • Our Patient Care Coordinators have excellent customer service skills.
  • Patient Care Coordinators learn new things – a lot! The Patient Care Coordinator multitasks in multiple computer programs each day.

A day in the life of a Patient Care Coordinator:

  • Greets everyone who enters the clinic in a friendly and welcoming manner.
  • Schedules new referrals received by fax or by telephone from patients, physician offices.
  • Verifies insurance coverage for patients.
  • Collects patient payments.
  • Maintains an orderly and organized front office workspace.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Fulltime positions include:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • 3-week Paid Time Off plus paid holidays
  • 401K + company match

The Patient Care Coordinator - I (PCC-I) supports clinic growth through excellence in execution of the practice management role and patient intake processes. This individual will work in collaboration with the Clinic Director (CD) to carry out efficient clinic procedures.     • Collect all money due at the time of service

title: Candidate Experience Coordinator, Cambridge, MA
description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 

 

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

 

Your impact 

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do 

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

  • Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.
  • Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.
  • Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.
  • Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

  • Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure  candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

  • Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.
  • Identify & Eradicate Bottlenecks: Proactively flag recurring scheduling challenges or process delays. You won’t just follow the process; you will help evolve it by suggesting improvements and piloting new workflows.

3. Enablement & Strategic Partnership

  • Scaling processes: Utilising AI, you will assist in documenting core processes for TA, creating clear and consistent guides for everything from complex scheduling to offer approval workflows. Additionally, you will ensure effective training for any new coordinators and wider TA members.
  • Champion Interdisciplinary Partnership: You will have opportunities for domain alignment with specific verticals, allowing you to build deeper context on the roles you support and partner closely with Hiring Managers, thereby leveraging diverse skills and perspectives across the business.

Skills and qualifications 

Essential:

  • Exceptional Organisation: Ability to prioritise multiple functions and tasks while maintaining the highest attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience Centric: A strong focus on providing the best possible candidate experience, with the empathy to manage relationships through the entire recruitment lifecycle.
  • Tech & Data Savvy: Experience using online calendar/meeting applications (G-Suite preferred) and a data-driven approach with a strong desire to advocate for clean data.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of keeping stakeholders updated and writing "human-first" correspondence.
  • Global Mindset: Experience scheduling and complex coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Process Mindset: The ability to learn complex systems quickly and a willingness to question "how things are done" to find better solutions.

Nice to have:

  • ATS Expertise: Deep experience with Applicant Tracking Systems, specifically Greenhouse
  • Project Management: Experience leading or contributing to operational projects (e.g., event logistics, data cleanup, survey rollouts).
  • Agency or Search Firm Experience: Experience acting as the main point of contact for external partners.


Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it. 

Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.


Creating an extraordinary company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. title: Designer
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

 

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

 

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production & QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

 Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

 

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

Department: Communications

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees. 
 
Scope: The Associate Press Secretary coordinates and executes communications strategies on key priorities determined in collaboration between themselves, their manager, and the Regional Field Director relating to the Sierra Club’s Energy and Conservation work in a set portfolio of states as designated on the Regional Turf Map. Any changes to the Regional Turf Map will be discussed and agreed upon in writing. Working with local staff, volunteers, and intersectional partners, the Associate Press Secretary is responsible for developing and disseminating strategic narratives that advance Sierra Club’s goals while remaining rooted in our organizational values: balance, collaboration, justice, transformation, and anti-racism To support that work, the Associate Press Secretary coordinates the development of creative assets to inform and influence decision makers; project manages the creation and distribution of advertising, videos, and other produced media; drafts and edits written content; and ensures messaging resonates effectively with various audiences. 
 
This position is responsible for an array of media communications, ensuring timely and accurate materials with a consistent tone and message. A key component of the Associate Press Secretary’s role is leading media outreach by organizing press conferences and other media events; coordinating the submissions of op-eds and letters to the editor; pitching stories; tracking and reporting coverage; compiling data; and nurturing relationships to grow a diverse bench of spokespeople. 
 
The ideal candidate should have a solid grasp of Sierra Club’s legacy conservation work, a conversational understanding of climate and environment issues, a personal commitment to and knowledge of social justice, and a passion for advancing progressive social change. They will also have the ability to articulate and reinforce the intersections of Sierra Club’s legacy work and communicate the challenges and opportunities we face, centered on justice and equity.

description: VERDANCY Aachen, Germany (RWTH Aachen) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AgTech & Biotechnology **About Verdancy **Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer. Bio-based microgels carry the active substance and release it on demand, while bi-adhesive peptides anchor the microgel to the leaf wax so the coating survives rain — meaning fewer sprays and less pesticide lost to the environment. A second product line uses bifunctional peptides (antimicrobial peptide + anchor) as peptide-based pesticides in their own right, protected by patent EP3261435B1. The entry market is copper fungicide against grapevine downy mildew, where there is no real alternative today, poor rain resistance is a known problem, and the EU is pushing hard to cut copper use. **The opportunity **Built on more than 10 years of university research across six projects (€7m raised, TRL 5), the startup is now being further developed by Susanne Braun (CSO, polymer chemist, carrier systems and formulations) and Atul Kumar (CTO, biotechnologist, protein engineering). Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027. What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone). Market access & commercialization - Accelerate market access for the copper-fungicide entry product (grapevine downy mildew), where regulatory pressure and poor rain resistance of existing products create a clear opening. - Build partnerships to validate the technology commercially and scale into the wider €80B crop-protection market. Fundraising & partnerships - Secure further funding from June 2027 onward, particularly to start the regulatory approval process. - Develop third-party-funded project relationships and networks alongside the existing €2.4m insect-focused project (starting Jan 2027). As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What you should have:

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines

  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts

  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

description: The Role We are the explorers. We are the builders. We are the Wayfinders. Bedrock is mapping the unseen world beneath our oceans and building the systems to do it at scale. You'll process and analyze multibeam, sidescan, magnetometer, and sub-bottom data from Bedrock field tests and commercial operations, and you'll own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality. When something looks strange in a dataset, you'll be the person asking what it tells us about the vehicle, the survey plan, or the seafloor itself. You will also be in front of customers discussing data quality, interpretation, and deliverables, and teaching them how to read what they're seeing and what it's worth. This is a role for someone who relishes that part of the job. And you'll be on the leading edge of the field. Bedrock is working with major governments around the world on how uncertainty and accuracy should be defined in ocean data- literally helping write the book, the policy, and the guidelines. This is the team revolutionizing how the seafloor gets characterized, and you'd have a say in what the next decade of this field looks like. We are hiring for curiosity, speed of learning, and real excitement about seeing the seafloor in higher fidelity than anyone has seen it before. If you have most of what's below and you're hungry to learn the rest, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Data Processing & Quality First-pass analysis of MBES, SSS, magnetometer, and/or sub-bottom profiler data using commercial software (Qimera, Seaview, SonarWiz, Radex, etc.) Own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality- first pass gets us information, not perfection Spot artifacts and anomalies, and reason about what caused them Work with Bedrock leadership and customers to hold the highest data quality standard in the industry Clients & Education Create data products and write-ups for commercial clients Serve as a primary point of contact for data quality issues, interpretations, and deliverables Teach clients about the unique value of AUV data, and what they can do with it- bring them on the journey rather than handing over a file Explain trade-offs, limitations, and uncertainty clearly, directly, and without defensiveness The Leading Edge Contribute to how uncertainty and accuracy get defined in ocean data-work that feeds into government standards, policy, and guidelines Collaborate with product and engineering on iterative improvements to the vehicle and to survey planning Help build the processing workflows that let all of this scale Who You Are You're a curious, fast-learning data person who wants to be on the vanguard of ocean data, and who would rather be in the conversation with the customer than behind it. Experience Experience processing and reporting on at least two of: MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler, using commercial software Comfort with ArcGIS, QGIS, and/or AutoCAD Experience writing data reports for commercial clients Attention to detail- you find the artifact nobody else saw Nice to Have Experience across all four relevant sensor types (MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler) Light coding (Python/SQL) Offshore experience (ship or AUV ops) Certified Hydrographer, Cat A or Cat B; Licensed Surveyor Experience across defense (mine countermeasures, unexploded ordnance), energy (oil & gas, offshore wind), and/or environmental survey How You Operate You learn fast, and you ask good questions when you are uncertain You treat processing as a problem-solving activity, not a checkbox exercise Iterative by instinct, you improve the data and the workflow with every pass Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change You use tools and AI to increase speed, accuracy, and leverage You are comfortable, clear, and collaborative in front of a customer What You Care About The idea of seeing the seafloor in a way no one has seen it before excites you You take pride in craft, clarity, and accuracy You have some connection to the ocean, professional, academic, or personal and you are excited to be around people who dive, sail, build, and explore offshore Not a Fit If... You want the data perfect on the first pass-iterative improvement is our way You are uncomfortable with uncertainty or with rapid changes in priorities You are not interested in learning new tools and approaches You do not want to interface directly with clients, or you see customer education as a distraction from the real work You are looking for predictable hours and firm boundaries around when the work happens. Actual salary offered will be based on qualifications, experience, and location (SF and NY being at the high end of the band). If you want to work on the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet and help decide what comes next in this field, we should talk.
